verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's docs say domains enroll in auto-renew by default and that an admin can open each domain to review its Auto-Renew status and expiration date, or disable auto-renew for that domain. That covers per-domain auto-renew control and expiry visibility in the dashboard. Missing for 10: documented expiry/renewal notification emails, documented grace and redemption windows after a lapse, and independent corroboration of renewal behavior.

support.subject: As an IT admin, renewals never surprise me — auto-renew controls per domain, expiry notices, and documented grace/redemption windows if something lapses

citations.quote: Cloudflare Registrar enrolls your domain to auto-renew by default.
If you decide you no longer need the domain, disable auto-renew for your domain. Once disabled, your domain will not renew upon expiration.
Select Manage domain to review the Auto-Renew status for your domain.
